def allnodes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        out.append((n['color'], min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
before = allnodes(current_frame)
res = action(['UP'])
print("UP2:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward')})
after = allnodes(current_frame)
for x in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.count(x)!=after.count(x):
        print("DIFF", x, before.count(x), "->", after.count(x))
